Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the TMC Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Medical Officer post at Tata Memorial Centre is scheduled for 29 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Medical Officer role, candidates must be M.B.B.S graduates who have successfully completed their internship from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Medical Officer position is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Medical Officer position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 104,000 to Rs. 114,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Tata Memorial Centre is recruiting for a total of 4 vacancies for the Medical Officer position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Officer post primarily involves a Walk-in Interview. A Written Test may be conducted if deemed necessary.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity at the Tata Memorial Centre.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Tata Memorial Centre office in Mumbai, Maharashtra (Pincode: 400012).

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.
